summary: Allocates a 260-byte object via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc and, when the output pointer a1 is non-null, stores it in *a1; when a1 is null the global unk_5E4CF8 is used as the working object instead. The object is then populated with two string copies (offsets 8 and 72) and a set of scalar fields: a4 at offset 0, a3 at offset 4, a7/a8/a9/a10 at offsets 200/204/208/212, zeroed dwords at offsets 216 and 224, a flag dword 1 at offset 220, a2 at offset 228, a byte flag 1 at offset 232, a zeroed dword at offset 252, and a11 at offset 256. Returns the populated object pointer. Called by sub_561BF0.

local_names.result: allocated object (or unk_5E4CF8 fallback) that receives the parameter copy
local_names.a1: optional output slot for the newly allocated pointer
local_names.a5/a6: source strings copied to offsets 8 and 72 of the object

operations.description: Call MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(260) to allocate the 260-byte object
Store the allocated pointer in *a1 when a1 is non-null; otherwise use the global unk_5E4CF8 as the working object

Write the scalar parameters to dword slots: offset 0 = a4, offset 4 = a3, offset 200 = a7, offset 204 = a8, offset 208 = a9, offset 212 = a10, offset 228 = a2, offset 256 = a11
Initialize flag and zero fields: dword at offset 220 = 1, byte at offset 232 = 1, dwords at offsets 216, 224 and 252 = 0
Return the populated object pointer (allocated object or unk_5E4CF8 fallback)
